warehouses.empty: This workspace has no warehouse yet.

add.title: Add a warehouse
add.description: The warehouse is created inside this workspace and you become its warehouse manager.
add.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Two warehouses may share a name.
add.noticeDescription: Creating a warehouse makes you its manager. Nobody else can be placed in it until you define roles there.

detail.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Warehouse names need not be unique.
detail.peopleDescription: Giving access places a person in this warehouse with a role defined there. What they may do inside it is decided by that role, not by the workspace — manage those roles on the warehouse's Access page.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.description: Archiving withdraws a warehouse from operation. It is reversible.
archive.stopsDescription: {{name}} stops being selectable and refuses every change to what it holds.
archive.keptDescription: Its roles, memberships and records are retained and stay readable, and it keeps exactly one manager so it stays administrable when restored.

archived.alertDescription: Its roles, memberships and records stay readable. Nothing inside it can be changed until it is restored.

lastWarehouse.alertDescription: It is the only warehouse of this workspace still in operation, and a workspace always keeps one, so its members are never left without a site to work in.

giveAccess.title: Give warehouse access
giveAccess.description: Place someone from this workspace into one of its warehouses with a role defined there.
giveAccess.roleDescription: You can see this warehouse's role names in order to choose one. This gives you no other authority inside it.
giveAccess.noticeDescription: That role changes only through the warehouse's own transfer, and you cannot place yourself into a warehouse that already has members.

withdrawAccess.title: Withdraw access to {{name}}?
withdrawAccess.description: The person stops belonging to this warehouse. Their other memberships are unaffected.
withdrawAccess.protectedReason: The warehouse manager's access is withdrawn only through the warehouse's own transfer.
withdrawAccess.ownReason: You cannot withdraw your own warehouse authority.
